status: SKELETON. Every unresolved value is null with an explicit blocked status. No hash, path, expected value or oracle origin is fabricated.
manifestRequirement: The fixture manifest must list branch coverage, seeds, cameras, settings, oracle origin and SHA256 before downstream work (plan §5). Only fixedInputs from the accepted plan are populated; unresolved fields remain null.
unresolvedConvention: null means NOT YET AUTHORED, never 'not applicable'. A fixture is not usable while any field it needs is null.

statusVocabulary.blocked-unresolved: Inputs are selected but the remaining numeric fields, expected oracle values and hashes have not been authored; the fixture may not be used.
statusVocabulary.blocked-held-out: Same as blocked-unresolved, and additionally withheld from implementation workers until U15.

policies.fixtureRole: Named fixtures are test data, never production conditions (plan §1).
policies.historicalMatrix: The historical effect-name fixture matrix is NOT used; the accepted report does not establish those effects' supported content (plan §5).
policies.authoring: U00 creates only independently authored data and expected values.
policies.oracleOrigin: Expected values come from independently written report-rule oracles (clone/spec/oracles.json), not from calling the production algorithm twice (plan §4).
policies.neverTune: Never tune expected results to produced art (plan §5).
policies.heldOut: H01 and H02 are frozen and withheld from implementation workers until U15; a final executor uses them unchanged and a failure leads to a general rule fix and reruns of both sets (plan §5).
policies.independence: Held-out sets exist for cross-module generalization rather than fixture tuning (plan §5).

sharedUnresolvedFields.expectedOracles: Array of expected values, each referencing a rule id in oracles.json.
sharedUnresolvedFields.settings: Full normalized settings object used by the fixture.
sharedUnresolvedFields.assetPaths: Clone-relative authored asset paths and their SHA256.
sharedUnresolvedFields.sha256: SHA256 of every authored input file and of the expected output set.
sharedUnresolvedFields.oracleOrigin: Which independently written oracle produced each expected value.
